outstandingProductGates: phase-4-2-static-content-renderer: prove a genuinely different static/content-oriented renderer over the existing Manifest/PageSpec/SectionSpec and design contracts, with standalone generated output that independently installs/checks/builds and passes browser acceptance. Evaluate Astro first; do not call a React/Vite wrapper a second renderer.
nextStage: Phase 4.2 — prove the second renderer with the smallest real marketing/content vertical slice. Keep the shared product/content/design truth renderer-neutral, make renderer choice explicit and explainable, and preserve ordinary generated-repository portability. After that, close only the genuinely missing professional-output capabilities before the product-proof freeze and varied real-business corpus.

deferredCapabilities.title: Deterministic design-intelligence catalogue
deferredCapabilities.reason: No component asks which reviewed design patterns fit this project. BrandSpec reads the knowledge pack's own brand observations, ArtDirectionPlan reads config/layout-patterns.json, and the Presentation Registry is compiled from what the template renders. A catalogue built now would have one producer and no reader.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: A real consumer cannot answer a project/industry/intent pattern question from deterministic config. Document that consumer first, then implement only the smallest lexical BM25/keyword catalogue it needs — no vector store, embeddings or generic design corpus.

deferredCapabilities.title: Visual reference analysis
deferredCapabilities.reason: No project currently supplies a screenshot, moodboard or approved design-reference input that requires decomposition beyond the brand observations already consumed by BrandSpec.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: A project supplies a screenshot, moodboard or approved reference URL and a real direction-selection decision needs layout, density, spacing, imagery or motion traits from it. Record adopt/avoid traits with confidence and source ids; never copy proprietary markup or treat reference content as authority.

deferredCapabilities.title: MessagingPlan
deferredCapabilities.reason: The current composition already carries page narrative, CTA strategy, proof gaps, audience and provenance. A second narrative contract would duplicate decisions with no reader.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: An art-direction or composition decision needs narrative information the existing composition cannot express, such as an evidence-dependent proof sequence or objection-handling order. Implement only fields that decision consumes.

deferredCapabilities.title: Visual comparison canvas
deferredCapabilities.reason: The ordinary Builder Console now performs the candidate comparison at useful width, including route/viewport switching, differing axes, responsive plans, lint, frozen truth and critic criteria. The observed failure was a narrow sidebar layout, not a missing canvas capability.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: A concrete review task proves the Console cannot support the required comparison, for example spatial arrangement of many candidates or freehand annotation that a reviewer genuinely needs to return.
